Items: a latte (about 350 ml, roughly 150 kcal), a Greek yogurt cup (about 100 g, roughly 70–100 kcal), two slices of toast (about 160 kcal), two fried eggs (about 180 kcal), a savory muffin with bacon (about 300 kcal), and muesli with oats, almonds and raisins (about 60 g, roughly 230 kcal). I assumed no milk with the muesli.

That gives roughly 1,110 kcal served. Some food will likely be left uneaten; I estimated about 150 kcal.
